pages.name: Home
groups: Brand at leading edge, privacy and overflow trailing. Profile switching remains reachable in overflow.
Ring is decorative at 44dp. Waveform at 32dp appears only for actual playback and is not a fake loading state.
24dp field-leading search; 18dp recent-query history. No permanent bottom search dock.
Three equal History, Saved and Downloads actions, with 24dp glyphs and visible labels.
When actual mode is audio-only, use compact labelled controls above navigation, not a fake video frame. Never coexist with video PiP.
Search, Games, Breathe in three equal 48dp-or-larger targets; 22dp outer horizontal gutters. Active tab uses a sage capsule and label.

pages.name: Submitted search
groups: Back leading; clear query within field trailing; overflow outside field. Search stays editable after submission.
List/grid toggle above results; filter only in supported filter menu. Selected display mode announced.
Overflow trailing each media row. Live icon appears only with verified live metadata. Duration is text.

pages.name: Watch / expanded player
groups: Collapse upper-left, overflow upper-right, play OR pause center, fullscreen lower-right. Exit-fullscreen replaces enter only in fullscreen.
Save OR saved, Background, Download and overflow below title/channel. Search and bottom navigation absent.
Disclosure trailing each section; queue leading title; row overflow trailing. Expanded/collapsed state announced.
Retain existing menus and conditional supported actions. Do not put every menu icon on the primary watch toolbar or introduce unavailable services.

pages.name: Results after player down-swipe
groups: Reuse submitted-search components and preserve query, filters and scroll. Only display current mode glyph and supported items.

pages.name: Saved / populated
groups: Saved title between back and overflow.
24dp leading glyph in labelled New playlist action.
32dp mark in 48dp tonal tile leading; chevron trailing. Reuse one mark, actual names/counts, no artificial artwork variations.
Rename and remove remain in existing actions; share only where supported by the current playlist implementation.

pages.name: Playlist detail
groups: Back leading, overflow trailing; same playlist mark at 48dp in header.
Leading glyphs inside labelled Play all and Background actions.
Reorder at start and overflow at end; 48dp targets. Accessible move-up/down alternative.
Only expose existing supported operations. Popup playback uses pip, not the expand glyph.

pages.name: Profiles sheet
groups: Close at upper-right in 48dp target. Handle is a native rounded line, not an icon asset.
Default avatar leading only when no actual avatar/initials; check trailing current profile. Initials remain real text.
Add leading New profile row; delete only in allowed existing profile management flow with confirmation.

pages.name: History
groups: Visible History title and existing overflow.
24dp leading privacy mark; native switch trailing, accurate enabled/disabled helper text.
Watch-row overflow trailing; search-query rows use history leading. Empty-state mark uses history at 48dp.
24dp leading destructive glyph beside Clear history. Confirm and clear only the active tab under existing rules.

pages.name: Games hub
groups: Four native GamePreview boards are illustrations/data, not navigation icons. Keep all four actual models.
Use only the controls implemented for each game. Back and help in toolbar; pause/resume/restart in labelled action area; board stays clear of PiP.
2048 Undo/New game; Sudoku pause/resume, notes, erase, hint, New puzzle; Make24 swap/undo/hint and text-only Skip/Next round. Snake retains gesture/accessibility steering without adding buttons.
Search, Games, Breathe in three equal 48dp-or-larger targets; 22dp outer horizontal gutters. Active tab uses a sage capsule and label.

pages.name: Breathe / Meditate
groups: 32dp decorative technique mark leading the row; 24dp disclosure trailing. Phase ring/timer remains a native animation.
Active Pause/End; paused Resume; completed Again. Setup Start breathing remains a labelled text action.
Use in supported sound/volume control presentation; do not replace the native Sound cues switch with an icon-only control.
Search, Games, Breathe in three equal 48dp-or-larger targets; 22dp outer horizontal gutters. Active tab uses a sage capsule and label.

pages.name: Saved / empty
groups: Same Saved toolbar as populated state.
48dp decorative empty mark, 24dp leading Create playlist glyph. Loading/error must not render this empty state.
Separate readable error text and labelled Retry action.

pages.name: Downloads / populated
groups: 32dp glyph in 48dp tonal tile, based on actual media type.
Pending pause; paused resume; completed check. Each mission shows real status/progress.
Failures show readable reason and Retry where possible; menu actions depend on mission support and permissions.

pages.name: Settings
groups: Settings title; settings search at trailing edge. This search is not YouTube search.
Player, Gestures, Download leading glyphs; row chevrons trailing.
History/cache, Feed, Backup; preserve preference destinations.
Appearance; Account; Content via globe; Content filter; Advanced. Match existing hierarchy and retain all preferences.
Only existing notification/destination/clear/explanatory controls; no new preference values.

pages.name: Downloads / empty
groups: 48dp decorative download mark. Surrounding progress ring is a native static decoration, not actual progress.
Retain supported media/quality/destination controls and permission validation. Form is specified; no dedicated raster mockup yet.
